sacrificándose para que la

toccare una coda.#W

Et nous~2c est-ce qu~27on peut
évoluer en entrant dans cette grotte?

it.text:
Possiamo evolverci entrando
in quella grotta~2c allora?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: I-ich auch!

en.text: M-me too!

fr.text: Moi... moi aussi!

it.text: Anch~27io!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich will ganz schnell zu
Smettbo werden...

en.text:
I wish I could be Butterfree
soon...

es.text:
Me gustaría poder llegar a
ser Butterfree pronto...

fr.text:
J~27aimerais tellement devenir
Papilusion au plus vite!

it.text:
Voglio diventare
Butterfree...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Toll! Ich will mich sofort
entwickeln!

en.text:
That makes me want to
evolve even more!

es.text:
¡Eso hace que tenga aún
más ganas de evolucionar!

fr.text:
Ça me donne encore plus
envie d~27évoluer!

it.text:
Se è così~2c voglio evolvermi
ancora!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh! Wirklich?!?#W
Ich...#W Ich bin vielleicht
stärker geworden?!?

en.text:
Oh! Really?!#W
I...#W I might be stronger?!

es.text:
¡Oh! ¡¿De verdad?!#W
Así que...#W ¡¿puede que ahora sea más
fuerte?!

fr.text:
Oh! Vraiment?#W
Est-ce...#W est-ce que je suis plus fort
qu~27avant?

it.text:
Oh! Veramente?!#W
Quindi...#W è probabile che io
sia più forte di prima?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Auch die Kraft und die
Fähigkeiten können dadurch verstärkt
werden.

en.text:
One~27s power and abilities
may be enhanced~2c for example.

es.text:
Por ejemplo~2c también
mejoran las habilidades y la fuerza.

fr.text:
La force et les talents d~27un
Pokémon peuvent être améliorés~2c
par exemple.

it.text:
Anche la sua forza e
le sua abilità possono aumentare~2c
ad esempio.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nicht nur das äußere
Erscheinungsbild verändert sich mit der
Entwicklung.

en.text:
Appearance isn~27t the only
thing that changes through evolution.

es.text:
El aspecto no es lo único que
cambia con la evolución.

fr.text:
L~27apparence n~27est pas le seul
changement qui se produit lorsqu~27on
évolue.

it.text:
Con l~27evoluzione non
cambia soltanto l~27aspetto esteriore
del Pokémon.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Entwicklung ist nichts
Schlechtes.

en.text:
Evolution is not a bad
thing.

fr.text:
L~27évolution n~27est pas une
mauvaise chose.

it.text:
L~27evoluzione non è una
cosa cattiva.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Mein süßes kleines Gesicht
ist ganz faltig geworden...

en.text:
My cute little face turned
all craggy...

es.text:
Mi linda carita ahora
parece muy agresiva...

fr.text:
Moi qui étais si mignon...
j~27ai l~27air terriblement féroce maintenant...

it.text:
Il mio bel faccino è
diventato tutto rugoso.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
A-augenblick mal.#W
Ich weiß noch gar nicht~2c ob mir das
überhaupt gefällt...

en.text:
W-wait a second.#W
I don~27t know if I like this or not...

es.text:
Espera un segundo...#W
No estoy seguro de que esto me guste...

fr.text:
Un... un instant!#W
Je ne suis pas sûr d~27aimer ma nouvelle
apparence...

it.text:
Un momento!#W
Io non so se questa storia mi
piaccia o no...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ach...#W
Ich will so schnell wie möglich zu
Smettbo werden...

en.text:
I wish...#W
I want to be Butterfree quickly...

es.text:
Ya me gustaría...#W
Quiero pasar a ser Butterfree rápido...

fr.text:
Et moi...#W j~27espère pouvoir
devenir très vite Papilusion...

it.text:
Come vorrei...#W
Come vorrei diventare Butterfree...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wenn ich mich entwickle~2c
werde ich dann so wie $n3?!?

en.text:
So if I evolved~2c I would
become like $n3?!

es.text:
Así que~2c si yo evolucionase~2c
¡¿podría llegar a ser como $n3?!

fr.text:
Alors si j~27évolue~2c je
deviendrai comme $n3?

it.text:
Quindi se mi evolvessi
diventerei come $n3?!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Und dadurch wurde das
Siegel dieser Höhle gebrochen.

en.text:
And perhaps that cave
became unsealed.

es.text:
Y quizá se abrió la entrada
a esa gruta.

fr.text:
Cela pourrait expliquer
l~27apparition de cette grotte.

it.text:
E quindi è probabile
che quella grotta sia diventata
accessibile.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nun~2c da der Stern zerstört
wurde...#W Ist auch das Gleichgewicht
der Welt wieder im Lot.

en.text:
However~2c now that the star
has been destroyed...#W
The world~27s balance has been restored...

es.text:
Pero ahora que el meteorito
ha sido destruido...#W
se ha restaurado el equilibrio del mundo...

fr.text:
Et maintenant que la
météorite a été détruite...#W l~27équilibre du
monde est restauré...

it.text:
Ora che il meteorite è
stato distrutto...#W l~27equilibrio del
mondo è stato ristabilito...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Vielleicht konnte die
Entwicklung nicht stattfinden~2c weil das
Gleichgewicht der Welt gestört war.

en.text:
Perhaps evolution could
not take place before because the world~27s
balance was askew.

es.text:
A lo mejor antes las
evoluciones no podían tener lugar porque
se había perdido el equilibrio del mundo.

fr.text:
... peut-être était-il
impossible d~27évoluer ces derniers temps
car l~27équilibre du monde était rompu.

it.text:
Forse prima non ci si
poteva evolvere perché l~27equilibrio del
mondo era sconvolto.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Es ist nur eine Hypothese~2c
aber...

en.text: This is merely a guess...

fr.text:
C~27est une pure hypothèse~2c
mais...

it.text:
Almeno credo che sia
così...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich vermute~2c dass die
Entwicklung in dieser Höhle stattfindet.

en.text:
I suspect that cave is where
evolution can take place.

es.text:
Supongo que la gruta esa es
donde ocurrió la evolución.

fr.text:
Tout laisse supposer que
cette grotte est un lieu où l~27on peut
évoluer.

it.text:
Credo che quella grotta
sia il luogo dove può avvenire
l~27evoluzione.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh~2c wow!#W
Das eigene Aussehen...#W
Das kann sich ändern?!?

en.text:
Oh~2c wow!#W
Your own appearance...#W
That can change?!

fr.text:
Hein?#W
Changer d~27apparence?#W
C~27est possible???

it.text:
Oh~2c wow!#W
Vuoi dire che...#W il nostro aspetto può
cambiare?!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wenn ein Pokémon sich
entwickelt~2c ändert sich sein
Erscheinungsbild.

en.text:
When a Pokémon undergoes
evolution~2c its appearance changes.

es.text:
Cuando un Pokémon
evoluciona~2c su aspecto cambia.

fr.text:
Au cours de cette évolution~2c
le Pokémon change d~27apparence.

it.text:
Quando un Pokémon si
evolve~2c il suo aspetto cambia.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wenn bestimmte
Bedingungen erfüllt sind~2c können sich
manche Pokémon entwickeln.

en.text:
Pokémon~2c upon satisfying
certain conditions~2c may evolve.

es.text:
Los Pokémon~2c cuando se
cumplen ciertas condiciones~2c pueden
evolucionar.

fr.text:
Lorsqu~27ils remplissent
certaines conditions~2c les Pokémon peuvent
évoluer.

it.text:
I Pokémon~2c se soddisfano
determinate condizioni~2c si possono
evolvere.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Entwicklung? Entwickelt?#W
Ich versteh gar nichts.

en.text:
Evolution? Evolved?#W
I don~27t follow.

fr.text:
Evolution? Evolué?#W
Qu~27est-ce que c~27est?

it.text:
Evoluzione? Evoluto?#W
Che cosa significa?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Entwicklung? Entwickelt?#W
Wovon redest du da überhaupt?

en.text:
Evolution? Evolved?#W
What~27s that about?

fr.text:
Evolution? Evolué?#W
C~27est quoi?

it.text:
Evoluzione? Evoluto?#W
Che roba è?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Snubbull hat eine
Entwicklung durchlaufen.#W
Er hat sich entwickelt.

en.text:
Snubbull underwent
~93evolution.~94#W
He evolved.

es.text:
Snubbull ha experimentado
una evolución.#W
Ha evolucionado.

fr.text:
Snubbull a simplement subi
une évolution.#W
Il a évolué!

it.text:
Snubbull ha subito
un~27evoluzione.#W Si è evoluto.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ja.#W
Und als ich wieder rauskam~2c
sah ich so aus.

en.text:
Yup.#W
And I came out looking like this...

es.text:
Sí.#W
Y salí con este aspecto...

fr.text:
Ouaip.#W
Et quand j~27en suis sorti~2c j~27étais comme
vous me voyez maintenant.

it.text:
Proprio così.#W
E quando sono uscito mi sono
ritrovato conciato a questo modo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Und da bist du also
hineingegangen...

en.text: So you went in there...

fr.text:
Alors tu es entré
là-dedans...

it.text:
E quindi sei entrato
là dentro...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Siehst du?
Da drüben.

en.text:
See?
Right there.

fr.text: Vous voyez? Juste là.

it.text:
Vedete?
Laggiù!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Sie erschien einfach~2c
ohne dass ich es bemerkt hätte.

en.text:
It appeared without me
noticing.

es.text:
Apareció sin que me diera
cuenta.

fr.text:
Elle est apparue sans que
j~27y prête attention.

it.text: È apparsa all~27improvviso.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Welche Höhle?

en.text: What cave?

fr.text: Quelle grotte?

it.text: Quale grotta?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich bin nur in die Höhle
gegangen und plötzlich...

en.text:
I went into the cave there~2c
and all of a sudden...

es.text:
Fui a esa gruta~2c y de
repente...

fr.text:
Je suis entré dans cette
grotte~2c là-bas~2c et tout d~27un coup...

it.text:
Sono entrato in quella
grotta e tutto d~27un tratto...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich verstehe es auch
nicht ganz.

en.text:
I don~27t really understand~2c
either.

fr.text:
Moi non plus~2c je ne
comprends pas très bien.

it.text:
Non ci capisco più niente
neppure io.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Aber du siehst ganz anders
aus als sonst!

en.text:
But you don~27t look anything
like the way you did before!

fr.text:
Mais tu as l~27air
complètement différent!

it.text:
Beh...
Sei cambiato parecchio!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Waaaaas?!?#W
DU bist Snubbull?!?

en.text:
Whaaaat?!#W
You~27re Snubbull?

fr.text:
Quoooi?#W
C~27est toi~2c Snubbull?

it.text:
Coooosa?!#W
Tu saresti Snubbull?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Ich bin Snubbull.

en.text: I~27m Snubbull.

fr.text: C~27est moi~2c Snubbull.

it.text: Io sono Snubbull.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ihm soll etwas
Merkwürdiges passiert sein.

en.text:
I heard something strange
happened to him.

es.text:
He oído que le ha ocurrido
algo extraño.

fr.text:
J~27ai entendu dire qu~27il lui
était arrivé quelque chose d~27étrange.

it.text:
Ho saputo che gli è
successo qualcosa di strano.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Sag mal~2c $n4...
Hast du Snubbull gesehen?

en.text:
Hi~2c $n4.
Have you seen Snubbull?

fr.text:
Bonjour~2c $n4.
Est-ce que tu as vu Snubbull?

it.text:
Ciao~2c $n4.
Hai visto Snubbull?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich habe gehört~2c ihm soll
etwas Verrücktes passiert sein.

en.text:
I heard something weird
happened to him.

es.text:
He oído que le ha ocurrido
algo raro.

fr.text:
J~27ai entendu dire qu~27il lui
était arrivé un truc bizarre.

it.text:
Ho saputo che gli è
successo qualcosa di strano.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Hey~2c $n4?#W
Hast du zufällig Snubbull gesehen?

en.text:
Hey~2c $n4?#W
Have you seen Snubbull around?

fr.text:
Hé~2c $n4!#W
Est-ce que Snubbull est dans le coin?

it.text:
Ehi~2c $n4!#W
Hai visto Snubbull in giro?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Hallo~2c $n4!

en.text: Hi~2c $n4!

fr.text: Salutations~2c $n4!

it.text: Ciao~2c $n4!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Erst muss ich mich
entwickeln~2c wie Safcon!

en.text:
First I have to evolve like
Metapod!

es.text:
¡En primer lugar~2c debo
evolucionar y convertirme en Metapod!

fr.text:
D~27abord~2c je dois évoluer
comme Chrysacier!

it.text:
Prima di tutto mi devo
evolvere e diventare Metapod!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh~2c ich will so schnell wie
möglich zu Smettbo werden...

en.text:
Oh~2c I hope I can be
Butterfree soon...

es.text:
Espero poder convertirme
muy pronto en Butterfree...

fr.text:
Oh~2c j~27espère devenir bientôt
Papilusion...

it.text:
Spero di poter diventare
presto Butterfree...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wenn du dich entwickeln
willst~2c solltest du die Höhle betreten.

en.text:
You should enter that cave
if you wish to evolve.

es.text:
Deberíais entrar en esa
gruta si queréis evolucionar.

fr.text:
Tu devrais entrer dans
cette grotte si tu souhaites évoluer.

it.text:
Se volete evolvervi~2c
dovete entrare in quella grotta.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich vermute~2c dass die
Entwicklung in dieser Höhle stattfindet.

en.text:
I suspect that cave is where
evolution can take place.

es.text:
Sospecho que esa gruta es
donde puede ocurrir la evolución.

fr.text:
Tout laisse supposer que
cette grotte est un lieu où l~27on peut
évoluer.

it.text:
Credo che quella grotta
sia il luogo dove può avvenire
l~27evoluzione.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Vielleicht bin ich ja
tatsächlich stärker geworden!#W
Ooh~2c wie aufregend...

en.text:
I might become
stronger!#W
Ooh~2c it~27s exciting...

es.text:
¡Puede que me haga más
fuerte!#W
Oh~2c qué emocionante...

fr.text:
Je suis peut-être devenu
plus fort!#W
Oh~2c comme c~27est excitant!

it.text:
Forse sono diventato più
forte!#W Che emozione!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wenn du die Höhle betreten
willst~2c musst du allein kommen.

en.text:
If you wish to enter the
cave~2c you must come alone.

es.text:
Me temo que~2c si quieres
entrar en esa gruta~2c debes ir en solitario.

fr.text:
Celui qui désire entrer dans
la grotte doit le faire seul.

it.text:
Per entrare nella grotta~2c
bisogna venire da soli.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Der Eingang zu dieser
Höhle ist sehr eng.
Man kann nur einzeln eintreten.

en.text:
That cave~27s entrance
appears rather narrow.
Only one may enter at a time~2c it seems.

es.text:
La entrada a esa gruta
parece muy estrecha. Creo que solo se
puede entrar de uno en uno.

fr.text:
L~27entrée de la grotte a l~27air
très étroite. Il semblerait qu~27un seul
Pokémon à la fois puisse y pénétrer.

it.text:
L~27entrata della grotta è
piuttosto stretta. Pare che ci si possa
entrare solo uno alla volta.

de.text:
Wir müssen uns mehr
anstrengen.

en.text: We need to do better.

fr.text:
Mais nous devons faire
encore mieux!

it.text: Dobbiamo migliorarci.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Mein Team #C5Hydro#R hat den
Bronze-Rang.

en.text:
My #C5Team Hydro#R is Bronze
Rank.

fr.text:
Nous~2c l~27#C5Equipe Hydro#R~2c avons
le Grade Bronze.

it.text:
Il mio #C5Team Acqua#R è di
Rango Bronzo.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Aber wir haben nur den
Normal-Rang.#W
Wie beschämend...

en.text:
But we~27re actually only
Normal Rank.#W
It~27s an embarrassment...

es.text:
Pero en realidad tan solo
tenemos el Rango Normal.#W
Qué vergüenza...

fr.text:
... en fait~2c elle n~27a que le
Grade Normal.#W
J~27ai honte...

it.text:
In realtà~2c però~2c abbiamo
raggiunto soltanto il Rango Normale.#W
È imbarazzante ammetterlo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Unser Team #C5Rumpelfels#R
ist für seine Wildheit bekannt...

en.text:
Our #C5Team Rumblerock#R
is famous for savagery...

es.text:
Nuestro #C5equipo Rocadura#R
es famoso por su brutalidad...

fr.text:
Mon équipe~2c l~27#C5Equipe Grolem#R~2c
est célèbre pour sa sauvagerie~2c mais...

it.text:
La nostra squadra~2c
#C5Team Romboroccia#R~2c è famosa
per la sua ferocia...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nicht schlecht~2c hm?#W
Wir überraschen die Leute mit
überragender Qualität.

en.text:
Not too bad~2c is it?#W
We surprise people with our excellence.

es.text:
No está nada mal~2c ¿no?#W
La gente se sorprende gratamente por
nuestra enorme profesionalidad.

fr.text:
Pas mal~2c hein?#W
Nous offrons d~27excellentes prestations!

it.text:
Non male~2c vero?#W
La nostra abilità è sorprendente.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Schätzchen~2c ihr solltet
wissen~2c dass mein Team #C5Klammer#R
inzwischen den Silber-Rang innehat.

en.text:
Darlings~2c I~27ll have you know
that my #C5Team Constrictor#R is actually
Silver Rank.

es.text:
Queridos míos~2c que sepáis
que mi #C5equipo Constrictor#R tiene el
Rango Plata.

fr.text:
En fait~2c mon équipe~2c
l~27#C5Equipe Tentacules#R~2c a le Grade Argent.

it.text:
Dovete sapere che il mio
#C5Team Morsa#R ha raggiunto il Rango Argento.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Schätzchen~2c wenn ihr viel
versprechende Rettungsjobs seht~2c solltet
ihr sie gleich annehmen!

en.text:
Darlings~2c if you spot rescue
jobs that seem promising~2c you should
try them!

es.text:
Queridos míos~2c si veis
anuncios de misiones que os parecen
prometedoras~2c ¡no dudéis en aceptarlas!

fr.text:
Si tu vois une mission de ce
genre~2c tu dois absolument l~27effectuer!

it.text:
Se vedete delle richieste di
soccorso che sembrano interessanti~2c
vi conviene accettarle al volo~2c tesori miei!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nur so am Rande:
Dieses Partnerareal zu bekommen~2c könnte
der Beginn von etwas Besonderem sein...

en.text:
Just maybe~2c getting that
Friend Area could be the start of
something enchanting.

es.text:
Puede que obtener esa
Zona de Recreo sea el comienzo de algo
encantador.

fr.text:
Peut-être que l~27obtenir
permettrait de commencer quelque chose
de merveilleux?

it.text:
Chissà~2c forse avere
quell~27Area Amico potrebbe dare inizio a
qualcosa di meraviglioso.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nun~2c es gibt Gerüchte über
ein neues Partnerareal!#W
Es soll #CHHimmelblauebene#R heißen!

en.text:
Well~2c lately there~27ve been
rumors about a new Friend Area!#W
The #CHSky Blue Plains#R~2c they say!

es.text:
Y bien~2c queridos míos~2c ¡he
oído últimamente rumores sobre una nueva
Zona de Recreo!#W ¡La #CHPradera Celeste#R!

fr.text:
Eh bien ces derniers temps~2c
on parle beaucoup d~27une nouvelle Zone
d~27Accueil!#W On l~27appelle le #CHPlateau Azur#R!

it.text:
Di recente~2c si parla molto
di una nuova Area Amico!#W
Si chiama #CHPiana Cieloterso#R.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ab und zu gibt es
Rettungsjobs~2c die dich mit einem neuen
Partnerareal belohnen...

en.text:
Every so often~2c there are
rescue jobs that reward you with a new
Friend Area...

es.text:
De vez en cuando hay
misiones de rescate que ofrecen como
recompensa una nueva Zona de Recreo...

fr.text:
... que parfois~2c certaines
missions de secours offrent comme
récompense une nouvelle Zone d~27Accueil?

it.text:
Di tanto in tanto si trovano
delle richieste di soccorso che offrono
come ricompensa un~27Area Amico...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Schätzchen~2c wusstet ihr
das schon?

en.text: Darlings~2c did you know?

fr.text:
Dis-moi~2c est-ce que tu
savais...

it.text:
Ehi~2c tesori miei~2c
lo sapevate?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich bin so unsagbar
glücklich!#W
Ich bin ein Glückskind!!!

en.text:
I~27m bursting with happiness!#W
Oh~2c I am so lucky!

fr.text:
Je suis fou de bonheur!#W
Quelle chance~2c mais quelle chance!

it.text:
Sprizzo felicità da tutti i
pori!#W
Quanto sono fortunato!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Meine Güte... Was für ein
Glück endlich Chaneira zu treffen!!!

en.text:
Oh~2c my gosh...
I~27ve finally met you...

es.text:
Oh~2c qué bien...
Por fin le he encontrado...

fr.text:
Ça alors~2c ça alors...
J~27ai rencontré Leveinard...

it.text:
Oh~2c incredibile...
Incontrare Chansey...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Du bist es!
Du bist es wirklich!!!#W
Habe ich ein Glück!

en.text:
You are! You really are!#W
I~27m so lucky!

fr.text:
C~27est bien toi!#W
Quelle chance!

it.text:
Sì~2c sei tu! Sei tu!#W
Quanto sono fortunato!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Bist du...#W
vielleicht...#W Chaneira?!?

en.text:
You~27re...#W
Maybe...#W Chansey?!

fr.text:
Est-ce que...#W est-ce
que...#W tu es Leveinard?

it.text:
Ma tu sei...#W
Tu sei...#W Chansey?!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

en.text: Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

fr.text: Ouaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!

it.text: Coooooooooooooooooooooosa?!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Was für ein Pokémon das
wohl sein mag?#W Würdest du ihm nicht
gerne einmal begegnen? #WAugenblick mal...

en.text:
I wonder what sort of
a Pokémon it is.#W Wouldn~27t you like to meet
one~2c even once?#W Wait a second...

es.text:
Me pregunto qué tipo de 
Pokémon será.#W ¿No le gustaría conocer
a uno~2c aunque fuera una vez?#W Espere...

fr.text:
Je me demande quel genre
de Pokémon c~27est...#W Tu n~27aimerais
pas...#W Mais... attends une seconde...

it.text:
Chissà che tipo di Pokémon
è. #WNon ti piacerebbe incontrare
Chansey almeno una volta?#W Un attimo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Es heißt von Chaneira...#W
dass es Glück bringt~2c es zu finden.

en.text:
This is what they say about
Chansey.#W If you are lucky enough to meet
one~2c you will be filled with happiness.

es.text:
Esto es lo que se dice de
Chansey:#W Si alguien tiene la suerte de
encontrarlo~2c conocerá la felicidad.

fr.text:
Voici ce qu~27on raconte à son
propos:#W si tu le rencontres~2c tu seras le
plus heureux des Pokémon!

it.text:
Di Chansey si dice che...#W
Se hai la fortuna di incontrarla~2c ti si
aprirà un mondo di felicità.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Irgendwo auf der Welt gibt
es ein extrem seltenes Pokémon...#W
Es heißt Chaneira.

en.text:
Somewhere in the world
there is an extremely rare Pokémon...#W
named Chansey.

es.text:
En cierto lugar del mundo
existe un Pokémon muy raro...#W
llamado Chansey.

fr.text:
Quelque part dans le monde~2c
vit un Pokémon extrêmement rare...#W
Son nom est Leveinard.

it.text:
Da qualche parte nel nostro
mondo esiste un Pokémon rarissimo...#W
che si chiama Chansey.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh~2c hallo!
Weißt du schon das Neueste?

en.text:
Oh~2c hello!
Did you know?

fr.text:
Oh~2c bonjour!
Est-ce que tu es au courant?

it.text:
Oh~2c ciao!
Lo sapevi?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich wünschte~2c ich könnte
Chaneira auch begegnen
und ganz viel Glück haben...

en.text:
I wish I could meet Chansey
and be filled with happiness...

es.text:
Me gustaría encontrar a un
Chansey y alcanzar la felicidad...

fr.text:
Comme j~27aimerais
rencontrer Leveinard et être empli de
bonheur~2c moi aussi...

it.text:
Vorrei incontrare Chansey
e conoscere la vera felicità...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh Wahnsinn!
Wie wunderbar für euch!
Wie ich euch beneide!

en.text:
Oh~2c my gosh!
How wonderful for you!
How I envy you!

es.text:
¡Vaya~2c es fantástico!
¡Me alegro por usted!
¡Qué envidia!

fr.text:
Inouï! Inouï!
C~27est merveilleux pour toi!
Comme je t~27envie!

it.text:
Oh~2c wow!
Deve essere stato fantastico!
Quanto ti invidio!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Was für ein Glück!
Wie hoch war denn die Wahrscheinlichkeit
dafür?

en.text:
That is so lucky!
What are the chances of that?

es.text:
¡Qué suerte!
¿Cuáles son las probabilidades de
que eso ocurra?

fr.text:
Quelle chance!
C~27est inouï!

it.text:
Che fortuna sfacciata!
Non è facile incontrarla!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
............#WOh-oh-oh?!?#W
Ihr seid Chaneira begegnet?

en.text:
............#WOh-oh-oh?!#W
You~27ve met Chansey?

fr.text:
... ... ...#W Qu... quoi???#W
Tu as rencontré Leveinard?

it.text:
... ... ... ...#W Oh-oh-oh?!#W
Hai incontrato Chansey?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Was für ein Pokémon das
wohl sein mag?#W Würdest du ihm
nicht gerne einmal begegnen?

en.text:
I wonder what sort of
a Pokémon it is.#W
Wouldn~27t you like to meet one~2c even once?

es.text:
Me pregunto qué tipo de
Pokémon será.#W ¿No le gustaría
encontrar uno~2c aunque fuese solo una vez?

fr.text:
Je me demande quel genre
de Pokémon c~27est...#W Tu n~27aimerais pas le
rencontrer~2c rien qu~27une fois?

it.text:
Chissà che tipo di Pokémon
è. #WNon ti piacerebbe incontrare
Chansey almeno una volta?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Es heißt von Chaneira...#W
dass es Glück bringt~2c es zu finden.

en.text:
This is what they say about
Chansey...#W If you are lucky enough to
meet one~2c you will be filled with happiness.

es.text:
Si tiene la suerte de
encontrar uno~2c conocerá la felicidad.#W
Esto es lo que se dice sobre Chansey...

fr.text:
Voici ce qu~27on raconte à son
propos:#W si tu le rencontres~2c tu seras le
plus heureux des Pokémon!

it.text:
Di Chansey si dice che...#W
Se hai la fortuna di incontrarla~2c ti si
aprirà un mondo di felicità.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Irgendwo auf der Welt gibt
es ein extrem seltenes Pokémon...#W
Es heißt Chaneira.

en.text:
Somewhere in the world
there is an extremely rare Pokémon...#W
named Chansey.

es.text:
En un lugar del mundo hay
un Pokémon muy extraño...#W
llamado Chansey.

fr.text:
Quelque part dans le monde~2c
vit un Pokémon extrêmement rare...#W
Son nom est Leveinard.

it.text:
Da qualche parte nel nostro
mondo esiste un Pokémon rarissimo...#W
che si chiama Chansey.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh~2c hallo!
Weißt du schon das Neueste?

en.text:
Oh~2c hello!
Did you know?

fr.text:
Oh~2c bonjour!
Est-ce que tu es au courant?

it.text:
Oh~2c ciao!
Lo sapevi?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Oh! Natürlich!#W
Papa~2c du bist der Größte!

en.text:
Oh! Of course!#W
Papa~2c you~27re so special!

fr.text:
Oh! Mais oui!#W
Papas~2c vous êtes tellement géniaux!

it.text:
Oh! Sì~2c scusa!#W
Lo so che sei speciale~2c papà!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Wofür hältst du mich?

en.text: What do you take us for?

fr.text:
Pour qui est-ce que tu nous
prends?

it.text: Per chi ci prendi?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)
PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Deswegen warst du weg...#W
Papa~2c hast du alle Pokémon gesehen~2c
die wir hier nicht kennen?

en.text:
That~27s why you were gone...#W
Papa~2c did you see all the Pokémon that
aren~27t known in these areas?

es.text:
Por eso partiste...#W
Papá~2c ¿has visto muchos Pokémon de los
que no viven en esta parte del mundo?

fr.text:
C~27est donc ça...#W Papas~2c
est-ce que vous avez vu tous ces Pokémon
encore inconnus dans ces endroits?

it.text:
Ecco perché te n~27eri
andato...#W Li hai visti tutti i Pokémon
che non ci sono da queste parti~2c papà?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Die Welt ist riesig.#W
Es gibt zahllose Pokémon in der Welt~2c
die wir hier gar nicht kennen.

en.text:
The world is vast.#W
There are countless Pokémon around the
world that are unknown in these areas.

es.text:
El mundo es muy grande.#W
Hay innumerables Pokémon por el mundo
que son desconocidos por estas latitudes.

fr.text:
Ce monde est immense.#W
Et il y a d~27innombrables Pokémon encore
inconnus dans ses contrées reculées.

it.text:
Il mondo è vastissimo.#W
Esistono Pokémon che non si sono
mai visti da queste parti.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Ich habe die Welt bereist.

en.text:
We were traveling the
world.

fr.text:
Nous parcourions le vaste
monde.

it.text:
Eravamo in giro per
il mondo.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Papa.#W
Wo warst du?

en.text:
Papa.#W
Where were you?

fr.text:
Papas!#W
Où étiez-vous passés?

it.text:
Papà.#W
Dove sei stato?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Mein Sohn~2c es tut mir Leid~2c
dass du dir Sorgen gemacht hast.

en.text:
Our son~2c we~27re sorry for
causing you anxiety.

es.text:
Hijo~2c sentimos haberte
causado tanta preocupación.

fr.text:
Fils~2c nous sommes désolés
de t~27avoir causé tant de souci.

it.text:
Figliolo~2c scusaci se ti
abbiamo fatto preoccupare.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Papa!

en.text: Papa!

fr.text: Papas!

it.text: Papà!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Ha!

en.text: Ha!

fr.text: Ha!

it.text: Ah!

de.text:
...Hmm...#W

...Hmm...#W

... Mmm...#W

de.text:
Wie er seinen Mund
kräuselt... Das ist anders als sonst.

It~27s different just a little at the corners.

labios.

Les plis au coin de sa
bouche sont... un peu bizarres.

it.text:
Le sue smorfie sono
leggermente diverse.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nein. Es ist andersss.#W

en.text:
No~2c it~27s different.#W
I can tell.

es.text:
No~2c ahora es diferente.#W

fr.text:
Non~2c pas comme
d~27habitude.#W Je vois bien qu~27il y a quelque
chose qui cloche.

it.text:
No~2c è diverso.#W
Ne sono sicuro.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich habe ihn nur lachen
gesehen; sein übliches fieses Gemecker...

en.text:
All I have seen is him
laughing in his usual mean way?

Yo solo lo veo reírse
como siempre~2c de forma malvada...

fr.text:

que d~27habitude~2c non?

it.text:

sulle labbra il suo solito ghigno...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Findest du?#W
Er sieht doch...
immer so aus~2c oder nicht?

en.text:
You think so?#W
His expression...
It looks the same as usual~2c no?

es.text:
¿Eso crees?#W
Esa expresión que tiene...
Parece el mismo de siempre~2c ¿no?

fr.text:
Tu trouves?#W
Mais l~27expression de son visage ne semble
pas différente~2c si?

it.text:
Dici?#W
Il suo sguardo...
Sembra lo stesso di sempre~2c no?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Genau... Er sieht immer so
nachdenklich ausss...

en.text:
Yeah... He looks like he has
a lot on his mind...

es.text:
Sí... Parece como si
estuviese muy preocupado...

fr.text:
Oui~2c on dirait qu~27il est tout
le temps plongé dans ses pensées...

it.text:
Sì... sembra che gli frullino
molte cose per la testa...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Was hat er bloß?

en.text:
I wonder what~27s wrong with
him?

arrive...

successo?

Gemeinheiten mehr mit uns aus...

en.text:
He won~27t do anything wicked
with us anymore...

fr.text:

it.text:
Non commette più nessuna
cattiveria...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

Na~2c jedenfalls ist Gengar
in letzter Zeit irgendwie komisch.

Something seems to be
wrong with Gengar lately.

Parece que Gengar está un
poco raro últimamente.

fr.text:
Je trouve qu~27il est un peu
bizarre ces derniers temps...

it.text:
Di recente~2c quel Gengar non
sembra avere tutte le rotelle a posto.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: ...Na gut.

..................#W

en.text:
..................#W

fr.text:
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...#W
Oh~2c je vois~2c tu te moques de moi...

... ... ... ... ... ...#W
Ah~2c stavi solo scherzando...

Dime~2c preciosidad.#W

estas misiones.

conoscere la nostra squadra.

we should handle the jobs that are posted

devrions nous contenter des annonces
affichées ici.

Visto che siamo all~27inizio~2c

troviamo qui nella Bacheca.

you can~27t do that rescue job even if you go

Si no seleccionas #C6Aceptar#R~2c
no podrás cumplirla aunque vayas
al lugar donde tienes que realizarla.

Si tu n~27as pas confirmé
avec #C6Accepter#R~2c tu ne peux pas effectuer la
mission~2c même en allant dans le donjon!

puoi soccorrere il Pokémon che ha chiesto
aiuto~2c anche se ti rechi in quel dungeon.

Then~2c on the #C5Job List#R~2c

#C6Take Job#R to go on that rescue mission.

Luego~2c en tu lista de
#C5Misiones#R~2c vuelve a elegir la misión y
confirma con #C6Aceptar#R.

#C5Missions#R~2c choisis celles que tu veux
effectuer avec #C6Accepter#R.

devi scegliere la missione e confermarla
con il comando #C6Vai#R.

select it with #C6Accept#R...

la misión y elige #C6Coger#R...

mission de secours~2c tu dois d~27abord la

missione di soccorso~2c prima devi sceglierla
con #C6Accetta#R...

secours y sont affichées.

Oh!#W

Oh!#W

friedlich...)

(Everything returned to
peace...)

(Tout est redevenu
paisible...)

ohne Angst leben. Danke!

without fear. Thank you!

a vivere senza timori! Grazie!

$n0!

$n0!

Oh~2c c~27est merveilleux~2c
$n0!

Oh~2c fantastico~2c
$n0!

Ehrlich~2c vielleicht mache ich
das nächste Mal bei euch mit!
Gahahaha!

Seriously~2c consider teaming
up with me! Gahahaha!

¡En serio~2c pensad en
colaborar un día conmigo! ¡Ja~2c ja~2c ja!

Sérieusement~2c vous devriez

Ga~2c ha~2c ha~2c ha!

ti metti in squadra con me?

en.text:
You were flat-out
incredible!

it.text:
Un~27impresa veramente
eccezionale!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

Oh~2c Schätzchen~2c du hast dich
selbst übertroffen~2c $n0!

Oh~2c darlings~2c you~27ve outdone
yourselves~2c $n0!

fr.text:
Oh! Tu as été
extraordinaire~2c $n0!

it.text:
Oh~2c $n0~2c tesoro~2c
hai dato veramente il meglio di te!

Hai scalato una torre di
nuvole?#W Non riesco neppure
ad immaginarmelo! Wow...#W che roba!

de.text:
Bitte informiere deinen
Freund darüber~2c dass die Rettungsmission
leider fehlschlug.

en.text:
Please inform your friend
that~2c regrettably~2c the friend rescue
mission ended in failure.

Por favor~2c informa a tu
amigo de que~2c por desgracia~2c la misión de
rescate ha fracasado.

fr.text:
Veuillez informer votre
ami(e) que malheureusement~2c la mission de
secours a été un échec.

it.text:
Non resta che dire all~27amico
in difficoltà che la missione di Pronto
Intervento non è andata a buon fine.

de.text:
Es tut mir so Leid~2c aber du
darfst diese Rettung nicht wiederholen...

en.text:
I~27m terribly sorry~2c but you
may not go on that rescue again...

Lo siento muchísimo~2c pero
no puedes volver a intentar ese rescate...

fr.text:
Je suis vraiment désolé~2c
mais c~27était la dernière tentative...

it.text:
Sono spiacente~2c ma non è
più possibile tentare quel salvataggio...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ah! Willkommen zurück!#W
Die Rettungsmission...#W
war ein Misserfolg~2c ich verstehe...

en.text:
Oh! Welcome back!#W
The rescue...#Wwent badly~2c I see...

es.text:
¡Vaya! ¡Otra vez aquí!
¡Qué bien! #W
El rescate...#W no ha ido bien. Ya veo...

fr.text:
Oh! Déjà de retour?#W
Oups...#W Ça n~27a pas l~27air de s~27être bien
passé.

it.text:
Oh! Che peccato!#W
Il salvataggio...#W non è andato bene~2c
allora...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Aber das war nicht
die letzte Chance! Gib nicht auf!

en.text:
But that wasn~27t the final
chance! Don~27t give up!

¡Pero esto no es el final!
¡No te rindas!

fr.text:
Mais il ne faut pas
abandonner! Ce n~27était pas le dernier
essai!

it.text:
Ma si può tentare
ancora! Non bisogna mai arrendersi!

Ich glaube~2c ich weiß jetzt~2c welches

Creo que por fin sé quién era ese

de.text:
............#W

............#W

... ... ... ...#W

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

it.text:

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Vielleicht...#W
Vielleicht bin ich...

en.text:
Maybe...#W
Maybe~2c I...

fr.text:
Peut-être...#W

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

That~27s it!#W

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

fr.text:

Elle m~27a dit quelque chose d~27important...

it.text:

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:

it.text: Penso di aver fatto ancora quel sogno...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
............#W

it.text:

... ... ... ...#W

... ... ... ...#W

$n0!

$n0!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:

it.text:

Mangiasogni?#W

tu deber es protegerle

it.text:
Da quello che hai detto~2c mi era sembrato
di capire che sapessi qualcosa.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: ...Na gut.

fr.text: Tant pis...

it.text: ... Non importa.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Nein... Es tut mir Leid...#W
Ich kann es nicht wahrnehmen...

en.text:
No... I~27m sorry to say...#W
I can~27t envision it...

es.text:
Lo siento... No lo sé...#W
No puedo ver ese lugar...

fr.text:
Non... Pardonne-moi...#W
Je ne discerne rien d~27autre...

it.text:
No~2c mi dispiace...#W
Non riesco a vederlo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wie es unter der Erde so ist?#W
Oder wie Groudon ist?

en.text:
What it~27s like underground?#W
Or what Groudon is like?

es.text:
¿Es tan malo el lugar al que voy?#W
¿Y Groudon?

fr.text:
... à quoi ça ressemble~2c sous terre?#W
Ou comment est Groudon?

it.text:
Sai com~27è laggiù?#W
Sai com~27è Groudon?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Übrigens...#W
Guardevoir~2c weißt du...?

en.text:
By the way...#W
Gardevoir~2c do you know?

es.text:
A todo esto...#W
Gardevoir~2c ¿podrías decirme algo?

fr.text: Au fait...#W Gardevoir~2c est-ce que tu sais...

it.text:
Senti~2c Gardevoir...#W
Tu sai com~27è?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich fühle mich schon etwas mutiger und
werde mich in diesen Dungeon wagen.

en.text:
I~27m feeling a little braver now.
I will go for it.

es.text:
Ahora me siento con más confianza para
emprender esta aventura.

fr.text:
Ça m~27a redonné un peu de courage.
Je vais y arriver.

it.text:
Ora mi sento più forte.
Darò il meglio di me.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich fühle mich schon etwas mutiger und
traue mich jetzt in diesen Dungeon.

en.text:
I~27m feeling a little braver now.
I will go for it.

es.text:
Ahora tengo más ánimos para emprender
esta aventura.

fr.text:
Ça m~27a redonné un peu de courage.
Je vais y arriver.

it.text:
Ora mi sento più forte.
Darò il meglio di me.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Das werde ich. Danke!

en.text: I will. Thank you.

fr.text: Je le ferai. Merci.

it.text: Certo. Grazie.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Du hast meine
Unterstützung. Bitte~2c gehe voller
Zuversicht.

en.text:
You have my support.
Please~2c go with strength.

es.text:
Tienes todo mi apoyo.
Estoy contigo...

fr.text:
Tu as tout mon soutien.
S~27il te plaît~2c aie confiance en ta force.

it.text:
La tua squadra avrà tutto
il mio appoggio. Fatevi coraggio!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich bin sicher~2c dass du
erfolgreich sein wirst~2c $n0.

en.text:
I am certain that you
will succeed~2c $n0.

es.text:
Estoy segura de que tendrás
éxito~2c $n0.

fr.text:
Tu vas atteindre ton
objectif~2c c~27est certain~2c $n0.

it.text:
Sono certa che le cose
andranno per il verso giusto~2c
$n0.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Es wird alles gut.

en.text: You will be fine.

fr.text: Tout ira bien pour toi.

it.text: Andrà tutto bene.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Ich frage mich~2c ob wir das durchstehen...

en.text: I wonder if we~27ll be OK...

es.text: Quién sabe si saldré de esta...

fr.text: J~27espère que tout se passera bien...

it.text: Chissà se ce la faremo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Ich frage mich~2c ob wir das schaffen...

en.text: I wonder if we~27ll be OK...

fr.text: J~27espère que tout se passera bien...

it.text: Chissà se ce la faremo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ja.#W Alle sagen~2c dass dieser Dungeon
schrecklich ist...

en.text:
Yes.#W They make it sound like one
terrible place...

es.text:
Sí.#W Todos dicen que es
un lugar espantoso...

fr.text:
Oui.#W On dit que c~27est un endroit
horrible...

it.text: Sì.#W Dicono che sia un luogo terribile...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Morgen~2c nicht wahr?#W
Morgen gehst du in den unterirdischen
Dungeon.

en.text:
It~27s tomorrow~2c isn~27t it?#W
That you take to that underground dungeon.

es.text:
Es mañana~2c ¿verdad?#W
Te adentrarás en las entrañas de la tierra.

fr.text:
C~27est demain~2c n~27est-ce
pas~2c que tu pars dans ce donjon
souterrain?

it.text:
È domani vero?#W
È domani che andrai nel dungeon
sotterraneo.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)
PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
......Ich habe......#W
wieder diesen Traum...

en.text:
......I~27m......#W
In that dream again...

fr.text: Je suis... #W encore dans ce rêve...

it.text:
... Eccolo...#W
Ancora quel sogno...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
............#W
Der Morgen zieht herauf.#W
Au revoir.

en.text:
............#W
It will be morning soon.#W
Au revoir.

fr.text:
... ... ... ...#W
Le jour va bientôt se lever.#W
Au revoir.

it.text:
...#W Fra poco farà
giorno.#W
Arrivederci.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
...Dieses Pokémon...
Ich glaube~2c es weinte~2c als es weglief...

en.text:
...That Pokémon...
I think ran off crying...

fr.text:
Ce Pokémon... s~27est enfui
en pleurant~2c je crois...

it.text:
Quel Pokémon se n~27è andato
piangendo...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
...Alles~2c was ich spüren
konnte~2c war ein Gefühl der Trauer.

en.text:
...All that remains in this
dream is a feeling of sadness.

es.text:
Lo único que queda en este
sueño es un sentimiento de tristeza.

fr.text:
Tout ce qui reste dans ce
rêve est un sentiment de tristesse...

it.text:
... Però ha lasciato in questo
sogno un~27atmosfera di tristezza.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Aber keine Angst.
Wer immer es war~2c ist weggelaufen.

en.text:
But it is fine now.
Whoever it was ran off.

es.text:
Pero ya ha pasado.
Quienquiera que fuese~2c se ha ido.

fr.text:
Mais c~27est fini maintenant.
Qui que ce soit~2c il est parti.

it.text:
Ma ora è tutto a posto.
Chiunque fosse~2c se n~27è andato.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
............#WWer war das?#W
Offenbar hat jemand in deinem
Traum spioniert.

en.text:
............#WWho was it?#W
Someone appears to have been looking
into your dream.

es.text:
¿Quién era?...#W
Parece que alguien estaba
fisgando en tu sueño.

fr.text:
... ... ... ...#W Qui
était-ce?#W Il semble que quelqu~27un
regardait dans ton rêve.

it.text:
...#W Chi era?#W
C~27era qualcuno nel tuo sogno.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: ...!#W W-was war das?!?

en.text: ...!#W W-what was that?!

fr.text: ...#W Qu~27est-ce que c~27était!

it.text: ...#W Cos~27è stato?!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
......#W
Doch...#W Wir werden uns
wiedersehen...#W Daran glaube ich.

en.text:
......#W
But...#W We will meet again...#W
That is what I believe.

es.text:
Pero...#W
nuestros caminos se cruzarán de nuevo.#W
De eso estoy segura.

fr.text:
... ...#W
Mais...#W on se reverra un jour...#W
Je le sais.

it.text:
...#W
Ne sono sicura...#W ci incontreremo
ancora.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Noch immer erfüllt mich
der Verlust meines Freundes mit Trauer...

en.text:
It fills me with sadness
still~2c losing my friend...

es.text:
Aún hoy estoy triste por
haberle perdido...

fr.text:
Cette perte me remplit de
tristesse encore aujourd~27hui...

it.text:
La nostra separazione
ancora oggi riempie il mio cuore di
tristezza...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Doch nun ist mein Freund
fort.

en.text:
But my friend has gone
away.

fr.text:
... mais mon âme sur a dû
partir.

it.text:
Purtroppo il mio amico
è andato via.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
In der Tat. Ich habe
diese Freundschaft sehr genossen...

en.text:
Truly~2c I cherished our
friendship...

fr.text:
Je chérissais sincèrement
notre amitié...

it.text:
La nostra amicizia
era tutta la mia vita.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
...#WAuch ich hatte
einst einen teuren Freund.

en.text:
...#WI~2c too~2c once had
a friend beyond value.

es.text:
Mira...#W Yo también tuve
una vez un amigo inseparable.

fr.text:
...#W J~27ai connu~2c moi aussi~2c une
amitié de grande valeur~2c autrefois.

it.text:
...#W Anch~27io una volta
avevo un amico che significava
tutto per me.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Es gibt Begegnungen~2c und
es gibt Abschiede...

en.text:
Because there are
encounters~2c there are also farewells...

es.text:
Para que hayan encuentros~2c
tienen que haber despedidas...

fr.text:
Quand il y a des rencontres~2c
il y a aussi des adieux...

it.text:
Nella vita ci si incontra~2c ma
bisogna essere anche capaci di dirsi
addio.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
...Aber das kann man
nicht ändern.

en.text:
...But there can be nothing
done.

es.text:
Pero me temo que eso es
algo que ni tú ni yo podemos evitar.

fr.text:
Mais on ne peut rien y
faire...

it.text:
Purtroppo~2c non c~27è nulla da
fare.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Wird es deinem Freund
das Herz brechen!

en.text:
Your friend would be
heartbroken.

es.text:
el Pokémon que más te
quiere se quedaría muy triste...

fr.text:
... ton acolyte aurait le
cur brisé.

it.text:
Se te ne vai~2c spezzerai il
cuore di chi ti è stato accanto fino ad ora.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

Deswegen~2c $n0...
Wenn du gehen musst...

en.text:
So~2c $n0~2c if you
were to leave...

fr.text:
Alors~2c $n0~2c si tu
devais partir...

it.text:
Pertanto~2c $n0~2c non
sarà facile per te andartene.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
$n1 fühlt sich
dir sehr eng verbunden~2c $n0.

en.text:
$n1 feels great
kinship with you~2c $n0.

fr.text:
Une grande amitié te lie à
$n1~2c $n0.

it.text:
C~27è un legame molto stretto
fra te e $n1~2c $n0.

$n1 feels great

en.text:
$n1......#W
I have to leave?

$n1... ...#W
Je devrai l~27abandonner?

$n1...#W
Devo andarmene?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ja.#W Das heißt...#W
Du musst dich von $n1 trennen.

en.text:
Yes.#W It means...#W
Parting ways with $n1.

es.text:
Sí.#W Lo siento...#W
Tendrás que despedirte de $n1.

fr.text:
Oui.#W Cela signifie...#W
que tu devras dire au revoir à
$n1.

it.text:
Sì.#W Significa...#W che dovrai
separarti da $n1.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Aber warte mal!#W
Das würde ja bedeuten~2c dass...

en.text:
Wait!#W
But that means...

fr.text:
Attends!#W
Mais cela signifie que...

it.text:
Ehi!#W
Ciò significa però...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ah...#W
Ich kann also wieder ein Mensch werden...

en.text:
Oh...#W
So I can go back to being a human...

es.text:
Oh...#W
Así que volveré a mi forma humana...

fr.text:
Oh...#W Alors je vais

Oh...#W così potrei tornare ad essere

de.text:
Ah...#W
Ich kann also wieder ein Mensch werden...

en.text:
Oh...#W
So I can go back to being a human...

es.text:
Oh...#W
Así que seré humano una vez más...

fr.text:
Oh...#W Alors je vais me
retransformer en humain...

it.text:
Oh...#W così potrei tornare ad essere
un umano...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Dann kannst du in deine
menschliche Welt zurückkehren.

en.text:
You can return to your
human world.

es.text:
podrás volver al mundo
de los humanos. A tu mundo.

fr.text:
Tu pourras retourner dans
le monde des humains~2c ton monde.

it.text:
Quando ce l~27avrai fatta~2c
potrai tornare nel tuo mondo.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ja.#W
Und wenn das vollbracht ist...

en.text:
Yes.#W
And when that is accomplished...

es.text:
Sí.#W
Y cuando lo hayas conseguido...

fr.text:
Oui.#W
Et une fois cela accompli...

it.text:
Sì.#W
E quando ce l~27avrai fatta...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
...#WDen Meteoriten aufhalten~2c
bevor er diese Welt zerstört...?#W
Das ist meine Rolle?

en.text:
...#WStopping the meteor from
crashing into this world...?#W
That~27s my role?

es.text:
¿Qué? #W¿Evitar que ese meteorito
destruya este mundo?#W
¿Esa es mi misión?

fr.text:
...#W Empêcher la météorite de
s~27écraser sur ce monde?#W
C~27est ça~2c ma fonction?

it.text:
...#W E quindi... il mio compito sarebbe
quello di impedire...#W la caduta del
meteorite?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Und diese Aufgabe...#W
nähert sich ihrem Ende.

en.text:
And that role...#W
It is soon coming to its end.

es.text:
Y esa misión...#W
está llegando a su fin.

fr.text:
Et ta fonction...#W
touche quasiment à sa fin.

it.text:
E ormai...#W la
realizzazione di ciò si sta
avvicinando.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Es ist zweifellos deine
Aufgabe~2c diese Welt zu retten.

en.text:
Without question~2c you bear
the role of saving the world.

es.text:
Sin duda~2c tu misión
es la de salvar este mundo.

fr.text:
Il n~27y a pas de doute~2c c~27est
toi qui dois sauver notre monde.

it.text:
Non c~27è dubbio~2c il tuo
compito è salvare il mondo.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Du hast deinen Mut
bewiesen.

en.text:
Your courage has been
proven.

fr.text: Tu as prouvé ton courage.

it.text:
Hai dimostrato il tuo
coraggio.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich...#W
Ich habe das freiwillig getan?

en.text:
I...#W
I did that?

fr.text: Je...#W j~27ai fait ça?

it.text: Io...#W ho fatto veramente tutto ciò?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Ich...#W
Ich habe das freiwillig getan?

en.text:
I...#W
I did that?

fr.text: Je...#W j~27ai fait ça?

it.text: Io...#W ho fatto veramente tutto ciò?

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
So kam es~2c dass du in
dieser Welt gelandet bist.

en.text:
That is how you came to
be in this world.

es.text:
Así es como acabaste
en este mundo.

fr.text:
C~27est pour cette raison que
tu es dans ce monde.

it.text:
Ecco come hai fatto la
tua comparsa in questo mondo.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Und so wurdest du freiwillig
ein Pokémon~2c um gemeinsam mit deinen
Freunden zu kämpfen.

en.text:
And became a Pokémon of
your own will to fight alongside your
friends.

es.text:
y así poder sentirte un
auténtico Pokémon con el deseo
de luchar al lado de los tuyos.

fr.text:
Et tu as choisi librement de
devenir un Pokémon pour lutter aux côtés
de tes amis.

it.text:
E così hai preso le
sembianze di un Pokémon per
lottare insieme ai tuoi amici.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Um deine Rolle mit reinem
Geist und Herzen zu erfüllen~2c wolltest du
alle menschlichen Erinnerungen vergessen...

en.text:
To fulfill your role
clear of heart and mind~2c you then chose
to erase your memory as a human...

es.text:
Para poder afrontar tu
misión~2c pediste que borrásemos tus
recuerdos de cuando eras un ser humano...

fr.text:
Pour jouer cette fonction
l~27esprit et le cur libre~2c tu as demandé
qu~27on efface tes souvenirs d~27humain...

it.text:
Per portare a termine il tuo
compito con animo sereno~2c hai voluto can-
cellare i ricordi della tua vita da umano.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Sollten wir dir die volle
Wahrheit sagen.

en.text:
Then you were to be told
the truth.

fr.text:
... que nous pourrions te
dire la vérité.

it.text:
... Ti avremmo detto la
verità.

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Und nur~2c wenn du dich
als würdig erweisen würdest...

en.text:
And only if you were found
to be truly worthy...

es.text:
Solo cuando no hubiera
duda de que eras quien buscábamos...

fr.text:
Et ce n~27est que lorsque nous
serions sûrs que tu le méritais...

it.text:
Solo se avessi dimostrato di
essere meritevole...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Batest du uns~2c dich auf
die Probe zu stellen.

en.text:
You asked that we put you
to the test.

es.text:
pediste que te
pusiésemos a prueba.

fr.text:
... tu as demandé à passer
une épreuve.

it.text:

We two...

Che cosa ne sarà

Ich habe das Gefühl~2c dass

Wir sind an einem

I think we~27ve come to

Ehi~2c $n0!

Und ich bin
schrecklich müde...

fr.text:

enfin dans un endroit désert...

Finalmente abbiamo
raggiunto un luogo dove non c~27è
anima viva...

...Äh~2c $n0?

...Um~2c $n0?

$n0?

And~2c I~27m feeling pretty
beat...

Y la verdad es que
ya no puedo más...

fr.text:
De plus~2c je suis à bout de
forces...

it.text: E sono quasi senza forze...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

Ich habe das Gefühl~2c

Ho anche l~27impressione che

I think we~27ve finally reached
a place where there~27s no one else but us.

Que por fin estamos en
un lugar en el que nos dejarán en paz.

fr.text:
Je crois que nous sommes
finalement arrivés à un endroit où il n~27y
a personne d~27autre que nous.

it.text:
Penso che abbiamo raggiunto
un luogo dove veramente ci siamo solo noi!

making progress...

llegaremos a la cima~2c $n0!

fr.text:
Assurons-nous d~27atteindre le
sommet~2c cette fois~2c $n0!

it.text:
Non possiamo permetterci di
mancare la cima anche questa volta~2c
$n0!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text: Wir waren schon nah dran!

en.text: But we were very close!

fr.text: Mais on était si proches!

it.text:
Ma eravamo a un passo dalla
fine!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Dieses Mal werden wir
den Gipfel erstürmen~2c $n0!

en.text:
Let~27s storm our way to the
top this time~2c $n0!

fr.text:
Atteignons le sommet cette
fois~2c $n0!

it.text:
Questa volta facciamoci
largo fino alla vetta~2c $n0!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Dabei waren wir schon
fast am Ziel!

en.text:
But we didn~27t have far to
go!

fr.text: Mais on y était presque!

it.text: Ma c~27eravamo quasi!

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Hmm...#W
Das war ein Fehlschlag...

en.text:
Hmm...#W
That didn~27t work out...

es.text:
Mmm...#W
No nos ha salido bien...

fr.text:
Hum...#W
Ça n~27a pas marché...

it.text:
Hmm...#W
Qualcosa non ha funzionato...

text_blocks.encoding: PMD Red western single-byte text (Latin-1 evidence view; ~XX markup preserved)

de.text:
Hmm...#W
Das lief nicht gerade gut.

en.text:
Hmm...#W
Well~2c that didn~27t go well.

es.text:
Mmm...#W
Vaya~2c no nos ha ido muy bien.

fr.text:
Hum...#W
Eh bien~2c ça s~27est mal passé.

it.text:
Hmm...#W
Niente da fare.
